## Purpose
The legacy ontology package. The taxonomy, tags and tagging moved to `app.catalog`, and industry knowledge moved to `app.knowledge`. Only the graph view (`ontology/graph.py`) still lives here. This file re-exports the catalog vocabulary under the old name.

## Responsibilities
Re-exports from `app.catalog.vocab`: `AGENT_TIERS`, `AgentTier`, `DataClass`, `Predicate`, `Scheme`, `SubjectType`, `tier_labels` and `tier_rules_block`.

## Key elements
The re-exports.

## Nuances and gotchas
